trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Read in full: a single six-sentence introductory paragraph on JWST compact objects. Judged all ten categories in context.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: TWO ITEMS reported, not fixed. (1) UNVERIFIABLE CITATION: the block names a specific object, 'GLIMPSE-17775', and the .ts carries no cites[] field at all. I could not verify the designation offline and did not guess; the GLIMPSE survey's widely reported extreme-Balmer-break object is catalogued under a different number in the literature I can recall, so this needs a reference before it is treated as a fact. (2) 'high-metallicity spikes' is the one item of the three-signature list I could not match to the standard Little-Red-Dot phenomenology (compactness, broad H-alpha, strong Balmer break, X-ray weakness are the usual four); flagged as needing a source rather than asserted wrong.
